C0611.title: Beijing No. 2 Intermediate Court Reports on Loan Diversion Cases Involving Financial Institutions
C0611.summary: The Beijing No. 2 Intermediate People's Court reported that among 118 adjudicated cases of loan diversion from financial institutions, nearly 30% involved credit card cash advances and subsequent re-lending.
